description: Get the page tree of a Doc (ClickUp Docs v3) — page ids, titles and their nesting hierarchy, without the full content. Use to navigate a Doc's structure before fetching a specific page.

doc_id.description: ID of the Doc whose page tree to fetch.

max_page_depth.description: Limit how many levels of nested pages to return. Omit for all levels.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_doc_page_listing
